meanings.en: to have a look, to take a look

examples.trans: Can I go and have a look?

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'коро'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Так, не шумим. Я скоро вернусь.
examples.trans: Right, no noise. I'll be back soon.
They put bad meat in there for you.

examples.text: Хочешь, сейчас и тебя туда увезут?
examples.trans: Want them to take you there too right now?

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.
Марина, я вам обещаю: со стеной ничего не случится.
examples.trans: Marina, I promise you: nothing will happen to the wall.

meanings.note: + prepositional; об before a vowel: об этом

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: Я тебе говорю = I'm telling you
+ instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

meanings.note: alone: 'я этого не хочу' = I don't want that

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.

examples.text: Меня уже тошнит от этой коммуналки! У нас труба уже неделю течёт.
examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat! Our pipe has been leaking for a week now.

meanings.note: the plural is a different word: люди, людям, о людях

examples.trans: There are a lot of people here.
I know the problems of ordinary people.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

examples.trans: I have no idea at all.

examples.text: Я человек чистый. Я вообще не вор.
examples.trans: I'm an honest man. I'm not a thief at all.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'нятие'). Common neuter noun meaning 'concept, idea, notion' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: I have no idea at all.
Max, I have no idea at all.

meanings.note: adult male; declines like a feminine -а noun

examples.text: У мужчины бывает не только жена.
examples.trans: A man can have more than just a wife.
This man is waiting for you.

examples.text: У мужчины, мальчик, бывает не только жена. Это моя девушка.
examples.trans: A man, my boy, can have more than just a wife. She's my girlfriend.

meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'арить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to give (as a present)', paired with 'дарить'.

examples.text: А вы мне тоже айфон подарите?
examples.trans: Will you give me an iPhone too?

examples.text: Паша, я больше не хочу о ней слышать. Понял?
examples.trans: Pasha, I don't want to hear about her again. Understood?

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('huge, enormous').

examples.text: Кстати, если хочешь, иди к нам в команду. Шансы у нас огромные.
examples.trans: By the way, if you want, join our team. Our chances are huge.

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'bouquet' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: He brought a bouquet of flowers.

examples.text: Я пришёл просить прощения. Я принёс этот букет.
examples.trans: I came to ask for forgiveness. I brought this bouquet.

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.
examples.trans: That can't be. It's our history.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

examples.text: Мы просто не хотели вас беспокоить. Всё отменим!
examples.trans: We just didn't want to bother you. We'll cancel it all!
The test drive is only for regular clients.

examples.text: Я тоже могу быть постоянным клиентом!
examples.trans: I can be a regular client too!

examples.text: Тест-драйв у нас только для постоянных клиентов.
examples.trans: Our test drive is only for regular clients.

meanings.note: at home, a party, or a restaurant

examples.trans: All the guests love them very much.

examples.text: Сегодня вечером к нам придут гости.
examples.trans: Guests are coming to our place tonight.

meanings.note: Core Russian pron meaning 'they' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Ты преподавай. А они пусть строят свои торговые центры.
examples.trans: You teach. And let them build their shopping centres.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'лишком').

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.

examples.text: Здравствуйте! У вас тут очень мило. Куда идти?
examples.trans: Hello! It's very nice here. Where do I go?
Nothing! He just sits there smiling.

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'friend' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: This is Vanya, my childhood friend.

examples.text: Это Паша, мой заместитель. Это Ваня, друг моего детства.
examples.trans: This is Pasha, my deputy. This is Vanya, my childhood friend.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

the infinitive 'Стоять!' as a police order

examples.text: То есть просто стоять и смотреть?
examples.trans: So we just stand and watch?

meanings.note: at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?
So I shouldn't wait for you tonight?
The wind is blowing hard outside.

examples.text: Я так два года потеряла. Любила так сильно!
examples.trans: I lost two years like that. I loved him so much!

переживать.gloss: to worry, to fret; to go through

examples.trans: Why are you worrying like that?
Don't worry, everything will be fine.

examples.text: Что вы так переживаете? Самсонов всё, он себя закопал.
examples.trans: Why are you worrying like that? Samsonov is finished, he buried himself.

meanings.en: to come up to, to approach

examples.text: Нам не нужна ваша приставка! Ещё раз подойдёте к моему ребёнку — пожалеете!
examples.trans: We don't need your console! Come near my child again and you'll be sorry!

examples.text: Я близко общаюсь с их информатором.
examples.trans: I am in close contact with their informant.
There's someone here to see you.

examples.text: Аркадий Борисович, извините, тут к вам человек.
examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, I'm sorry, there's a man here to see you.

meanings.note: accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.trans: Oh, Samson. What have you come for?

подходить.gloss: to approach, to come up; to suit

meanings.note: очередь подходит = one's turn is coming up
это мне подходит = that suits me

examples.trans: Let's go, our turn in the queue is coming up.
The train is approaching the station.

examples.text: Я к печке подхожу. А он маячит перед глазами!
examples.trans: I walk up to the stove. And it dangles right before my eyes!

examples.text: Они заняли свободный столик у окна.
examples.trans: They took a free table near the window.
Would you like to sit at an available table?
To a guest at the next table.

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

meanings.note: Prefix 'об-' ('around, about') marks encirclement or comprehensive action (stem 'суждать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to discuss', paired with 'обсудить'.

examples.trans: Well, we've been discussing everything here.

examples.text: Ты не обсуждай, ты действуй! Самсонова надо ликвидировать!
examples.trans: Don't discuss, act! Samsonov must be eliminated!
All right, here you go. There, look.
Can I go and have a look?

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'знавать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to recognise; to find out', paired with 'узнать'.

examples.text: Узнаёшь? У нас здесь ничего не изменилось.
examples.trans: Recognise it? Nothing has changed here.

meanings.note: спасибо за + accusative = thank you for

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.
So I shouldn't wait for you tonight?
